reviews.title: Works as intended!!!
reviews.comment: I have purchased G.Skill RAM for new builds and upgrades. The 16Gb TridentZ RGB RAM purchased works as intended. I have configured the RAM for 3600MHz through the Motherboard BIOS XMP and have had no issues with running the RAM at that speed. The RGB LEDs on the RAM are configurable through the downloadable utility from G.Skill. I have included pics of the RAM sticks in operation, the utility to show RAM running at 3600MHz and the G.Skill Utility. I will continue to purchase their RAM in the future!
reviews.author: Jim Robertson

reviews.title: Great 3700x memory with Asus Tuf X570 mobo
reviews.comment: Purchased a second 3600mhz kit running with 3700x & x570 Tuf gaming mobo.  Runs great.  After bios update aura and bios was able to turn off and adjust rgb.
reviews.author: Yellow, Hello

reviews.title: Good for the overclocker at heart
reviews.comment: Ryzen 1700X at 4GHz and these two 8GB at 3600MHz. Default of 1.35v with C-state off. Manually set 16-16-16-36-52 XMP timings on Asus Strix X370-F. It's single rank Samsung B die. All is running cool (AIO)and very good low voltages. Still in process of getting stable as I believe the occasional game executable dumping (my only problem)is due to the memory, but not positive. If you like tinkering with clocking, I say go for it. At this point, I'd rather have known memory stability piece of mind and the recommended G.Skill Flare X 3200 for Ryzen's. I guess the talk of Infinity Fabric and the pretty lights lured me.
reviews.author: flow

reviews.title: Works well with Ryzen 1700X build.
reviews.comment: No problems so far, I wanted to use it with my Ryzen 1700X build. I was able to reach around 3333 MHz stable and noticed improvements on game framerates. I still need to explore and OC the RAM further when I get time. At least the device has Samsung B-Die DDR4 so OC potential should be better. He's hopping to hit near 4GHz RAM speed at a later point.
reviews.author: VG
